subject: My shiny.io application is grayish and it is not working

messages.author: cdd3dec613e60ee2
messages.subject: My shiny.io application is grayish and it is not working
parts:
Hi all
I'm kind of desperate!
shinyapps'A few hours ago just loaded a new application from RStudio and It was working properly. 
Now I made a minor correction to the script and the shiny.io application does not work anymore. (in an ifelse statement I change the true and false values)
The application works fine locally, but when I upload this new version it shows grayish and I can not interact at all. There were no warning when I upload the new version except Error: 'accounts' is not an exported object from 'namespace:shinyapps'. But the same error did appear with the first upload and the application was fine. I also restarted the application a couple of times and nothing.
Any help would be appreciated
Oscar
